evidence.text: A neighbor recalls seeing the moving truck on Tuesday.
The utility transfer request is dated Tuesday.
The old landlord says the keys were returned Monday.
A grocery receipt from the new address is dated Wednesday.
The night log shows no badge swipe after 18:00.
A coworker recalls a brief hallway chat around 19:00.
The parking camera shows the car leaving at 17:40.
The chat message timestamps suggest presence until 19:20.
The seed packet label lists the variety as heirloom.
The nursery catalog describes the variety as heirloom.
A gardening forum regular identifies it as heirloom.
The supplier's invoice uses a hybrid variety code.
The invoice total matches the quoted estimate.
The foreman confirms the quoted scope.
The homeowner recalls discussing extra work.
A text message mentions additional fixtures.
The signed change order is blank.
The brochure photograph shows a sunny courtyard.
A review mentions occasional noise.
The listing highlights the renovation.
The inspection report documents structural cracking; the listing's photos predate the inspection.
The agent describes the building as solid.
The menu board lists the dish as spicy.
A diner review calls it mild.
The chef's recipe card specifies no chili; the menu board was for a different dish.
The server warned it might be hot.
The travel blog praises the hotel's view.
A guest photo shows a clean lobby.
One review complains about slow elevators.
Another review mentions thin walls.
The health department's report grades it A; the complaints predate the new management.
The first witness says the light was green.
The second witness agrees it was green.
The taxi driver says it was red.
A pedestrian thought it looked red.
The junior analyst flags the anomaly.
The automated monitor also flagged it.
The senior analyst calls it a sensor glitch.
The maintenance log notes a sensor fault that day.
The diary entry describes a calm sea.
The ship's log records rough seas.
A second logbook agrees with rough seas.
The diary was written the same evening.
The credit file shows a missed payment.
The borrower produces a bank transfer receipt.
The bank confirms the transfer was processed.
The credit file was updated before the transfer cleared.
The ranger's field notes record the rare bird's call.
A second ranger independently logs the same call.
The acoustic monitor's log matches the call pattern.
A respected ornithologist's letter insists the call was a common mimic; the letter predates the monitor data.
Two tellers count the drawer as short.
The end-of-day tape confirms the shortage.
The branch manager's memo asserts the count was correct; the memo was written before the tape was run.
The soil test shows adequate nitrogen.
The extension agent's visit notes healthy growth.
Last year's yield was above average.
A fertilizer salesman's flyer claims the field is depleted; the flyer cites no test.
